# Sandesh Jung Kunwar

> AI/ML Engineer based in Kathmandu, Nepal. Builds LLM training/evaluation pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, AI agents, and the production software that carries them.

## Key facts

- Core skills: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents (LangChain/LangGraph), RLHF, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, FastAPI, React, AWS

## About

Sandesh is an AI/ML engineer working across LLM training and evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agent orchestration, and the production systems and interfaces around them. He has built and evaluated code generation agents, multi-agent workflows, and RLHF-based model evaluations, and has shipped his own full-stack products.
